design_amendment.clarification: The earlier design proposed complete unique public sector coverage as a prerequisite. The final registered implementation constrains eleven rows and public code syntax but treats duplicate/missing coverage and source identity mismatch as NONBLOCKING diagnostics, so these original error dimensions remain observable. The calculator records allocation errors and passes them to the next stage. Earlier file is preserved unchanged.
design_amendment.reason: Do not turn malformed financial decisions into schema-forced correct allocations, and permit documented reconsideration at the next task stage.

evidence_basis.distinction: FinVector supports explicit task-schema prompting in its own setting. Ollama API grammar is a documented engineering adaptation. The combined intervention is not a replication of private prompts and does not identify its component effects.

denominator_policy: Retain the original final-source extraction denominator11 for each attempted registered case. A missing final response contributes0 correct, while completed-response semantic analysis and missing portfolio diagnostics remain null. Intermediate stages are not four independent cases. Preserve v4.4 and v4.5 separately; no successful-case-only improvement claim.
important_limits: A structurally valid answer may still repeat irrelevant input inside free-text fields or provide unsupported reasons; round3 semantic review remains required.
The common code vocabulary and array length are controlled response-format dimensions, not independent evidence of model accuracy.
The frozen code is tested against deterministic fixtures, not a real-model completion guarantee or a performance benchmark.
Schema guidance increases input length and grammar alters token selection. Four-stage capacity and deadline success remain empirical questions; no silent context truncation is authorized.
The source interpretation rubric and financial arithmetic are unchanged. No target weights, risk-aversion coefficient, invented bound or weighted quality score is added.
One repeated development case cannot identify R1/R4 effects or institutional convergence. Main stays unfrozen.

author_test_result.review_scope: Test source inspected; independent pure probes and four-stage deterministic fixture run recorded above. No duplicate real inference or whole-suite run.
